final_result: Added a small OTA query PoC that compares API-only coverage against degraded API+DOM recovery for both Station and Naver.
Reclassified OTA query from `hold` to `bridge-candidate` in the app-centric transition plan.
verified_facts: In the PoC, both providers returned 9 API rows and 0 DOM rows in the healthy API-only path.
In the degraded path, both providers recovered from 3 API rows to 9 covered rows only after DOM merge.
`node tests/regression_pms_fetch_wings_post.mjs` also passed after exporting the coverage helper.
memory_updates: Prepared a reusable memory entry capturing the rule: API-only success plus degraded DOM recovery implies `bridge-candidate`, not `app-first`.
remaining_risks: The PoC is synthetic and does not quantify live-session low-coverage frequency.
not_done: No runtime instrumentation was added yet to measure real OTA low-coverage incidence.
next_step: If you want to decide whether OTA query can ever move from `bridge-candidate` to `app-first`, add runtime counters around `fetchProviderRows` for API-only accept, DOM merge, and DOM-only fallback frequency.
